lines.trans: Where are we? Smoke and bomb craters are all around.
Crawl forward! We have almost arrived.
We have been crawling through mud for so long!
Tomorrow the final battle awaits us.
Just a little more, just a little bit!
This battle will be the hardest one.
My grandfather was not a traitor!
Everyone knows the truth. Hold on, soldier!
And I want to go home to Russia.
Soon we will return home.
I haven't seen my mother in so long.
Mother is waiting for you alive.
I will not betray my native land!
Then wake up, Ivan! It is time for you.

meanings.note: also used affectionately to a boy: 'lad, trooper'

examples.trans: Why are you so sad, soldier?
The soldiers were heading into battle.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: direction: идти вперёд = to go forward
colloquial, like a preposition + genitive: лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

дойти.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.text: Но они, к сожалению, не дошли до вас.
examples.trans: But unfortunately, it never reached you.
We quickly walked as far as the house.
He talks for a long time.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.
Cutting a living person with a knife!
You can't torture a living person like that!
A meter fifty off the ground!
I was born and grew up here.
Oh, there is snow all around here!
There was thick forest all around.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: I will not betray my native land.

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.en: a little bit, just a little

examples.text: Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
Wait just a little bit longer.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
